messages:
pavan: Quick alert 10x H100s from Wave-41 at MXL flagged for export docs mismatch. Forwarder suggests intermodal diversion to LHR via SFO/ORD (air-sea combo) to keep EU capacity stable.

emily: This tranche is earmarked for pool-eu-burst as RMA replacements + scheduled top-off. If we lose these to long sea delays we burn SLA credits. Vendor options?

vendor-auris: We can do two routes: A) intermodal air-sea via SFO -> LHR door (air leg MXL->SFO overnight, then charters to LHR, delta +18% freight) or B) hold at MXL for next full container sail (+96h) and prioritize at port (no freight uplift). Both require AWB adjustments and serial mapping.

pavan: Ops constraint: our facilities team in LHR needs a 48h pre-alert for crate dims and fork requirements. Also customs clearance windows in LHR are tight Mon-Wed.

freight-bot: Logistics ticket created: AUR-INT-2024-9000 "MXL export mismatch -> intermodal to LHR". Assigned to @vendor-auris + @ops-team.

emily: Cost ask 1route A: give us a line-item estimate (air leg + handling + insurance + carriage to LHR). Also confirm how you will annotate manifests so units auto-claim into pool-eu-burst as REDWOOD-RMA.

vendor-auris: Estimate (route A): air uplift +18% on base freight, handling $520/unit for air manifesting and local ground, insurance +0.9% declared value, charter consolidation fee $2,000 per booking. We'll tag manifests with ref=REDWOOD-RMA and include serial CSV.

customs-bot: Note: moving via US hub (SFO/ORD) requires re-export docs and ECCN on the commercial invoice. If units are re-declared as "modules" instead of "complete servers" duty may differ. Please align with PO classification.

emily: We need vendor credit policy spelled out: if serial mismatch >2 units on arrival or missing RMA labels, vendor must provide immediate credit + replacement SLA (48h).

vendor-auris: Acceptable. We'll accept credit clause for mismatches >2 units. We'll also append outbound return labels for 6 DOAs in the same shipment manifest. RMA portal: https://vendor.auris.example.com/rma?ref=REDWOOD-2024-9211

pavan: Pre-emptive allocation step: once AWBs are uploaded, ops will run the earmark command to pin to pool-eu-burst. Snippet: 
```
# earmark to pool-eu-burst
python ops/earmark.py --pool pool-eu-burst --tag REDWOOD-RMA --awbs 900-111222,900-111223,900-111224
```

vendor-auris: Provisonal AWBs for the first air-split leg: 
```
AWB: 900-111222
AWB: 900-111223
AWB: 900-111224
```

vendor-auris: We'll upload full serial list + crate dims within 90m. If MXL customs hold extends beyond 72h we'll recommend direct rebook to MAN (Manchester) for lower UK clearance queues as fallback (+4-6h transit delta).

emily: Approved conditionally for Route A (intermodal) for the 6 highest-priority units. Hold the remaining 4 for sea if MXL clears within 48h. Vendor: please update invoice addendum to bill air uplift to PO# 2024-9211. Finance will review.

ops-team: Facilities note: LHR team needs crate dims, weights, and a forklift spec (jaw width) so we can book an inbound slot. Also request pre-alert with serials so inventory can stage immediate tagging.

pavan: Vendor: ensure AWB manifest includes a manifest reference column with REDWOOD-RMA and the PO# to avoid allocation mix-ups on arrival.

vendor-auris: Affirmative. We'll include a manifest ref like: "REF: REDWOOD-RMA | PO:2024-9211" and upload to portal. Portal upload link: https://vendor.auris.example.com/portal/uploads

freight-bot: Reminder scheduled: 6h check-in for AUR-INT-2024-9000.

emily: Last ask  can vendor provide a single consolidated invoice addendum showing freight uplift, handling, insurance delta, and any projected duty differences for UK entry? We'll need that for finance approval.

vendor-auris: Will send invoice addendum in ~60m and confirm AWB/serial upload. We'll hold billing until confirmation from ops to avoid double-charging if sea is chosen.

pavan: Thanks team. Once AWBs live ops will run earmark and facilities will prep. Keep this thread for docs only. :white_check_mark:
